rss.title: Nov 13, 2026: The ethical stakes of being a public scholar
rss.description:
The Center on Ethics presents a conversation with David M. Perry (Associate Director of Undergraduate Studies in the Department of History at the University of Minnesota-Twin Cities and author of The Public Scholar: A Practical Handbook) about the ethical stakes of being a public scholar.

This virtual event is free and open to the public, but pre-registration is required at https://forms.gle/i89nvimd8PZiBh7A7
